prompt:

Composition: square canvas, ONE centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, subtle natural three-quarter shoulder angle with face toward viewer and gentle smile from source, rounded lower shoulder silhouette, entire head, hair and both ears fully inside frame with generous transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Completely remove the cropped adjacent person on the right, room, flowers, cabinet, painting and all scenery. No other people, props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
